result:
All research is complete. Here are the compiled answers:

---

**h01**: S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) — runs every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, line 27) — wired in `server/server.go:153-173` via `startBackgroundRunners()`, which creates the runner (line 162), calls `RunOnce` immediately (line 163), and launches `Run` in a goroutine (line 169); `startBackgroundRunners` is called from `Server.Start()` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02**: Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (async path via `PostAsync` at line 184, enqueuing to a buffered channel drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()`). Protection mechanism — SSRF guard via `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, which resolves DNS and checks every IP against `isReservedIP()` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:44` (blocks RFC-1918, link-local, loopback CIDRs defined at lines 14-23). Input-time validation also in `ValidateURL()` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`.

**h03**: Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct in `internal/idp/idp.go`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol implementation in `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

**h04**: No. Evidence: `grep -rn "mysql.NewDB\|mysql.New("` finds only `store/db/db.go:22` (the factory). `grep` for the import path `"github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql"` finds only `store/db/db.go:8`. The `mysql` import in `store/test/containers.go` is the testcontainers module (`github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/mysql`), not the memos driver package.

**h05**: Explicit Go code. In `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go` (and identically in mysql and postgres variants), the function `deleteUserTargetsTx` performs two explicit DELETEs: (1) `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (line 96) deletes reactions on the user's memos, and (2) `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (line 102) deletes reactions the user placed on others' memos. The `reaction` table schema has no foreign keys or CASCADE rules.

**h06**: Handlers: (1) `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), (2) `UpdateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`), (3) `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`), (4) `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), (5) `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`), (6) `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`). Convergence function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07**:
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks user cache, falls through to `ListUsers`)
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `driver.ListUsers` (e.g. `sqlite.DB.ListUsers`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (SQL query on `user` table)
- `parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` (decodes base64 avatar from `AvatarURL` field)

**h08**:
- `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked: yes — callers: `server/server.go:163` (`s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)`) and self-call from `Run` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked: no — zero production callers

**h09**: 6 distinct `Close` declarations in the backend. All 6 are called by non-test server code:
- `SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`) — caller: `server/server.go:206`
- `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`) — caller: `server/server.go:146`
- `Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`) — caller: `store/store.go:74-76` (three cache instances)
- `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`) — caller: `store/store.go:78` via `s.driver.Close()`
- `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`) — caller: same driver interface dispatch
- `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`) — caller: same driver interface dispatch

**h10**: `(*Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — approx 38 callers (7 production call sites across `internal/filter/helpers.go`, `server/router/api/v1/`, and `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/`, plus ~31 test call sites).

**h11**: 1st: Memo (~6 packages, ~113 references); 2nd: User (~6 packages, ~107 references). Third place is Attachment at ~4 packages.

**h12**: `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16-52` (executes `INSERT INTO memo ... RETURNING ...` at line 41). Determination: `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, so `store/db/db.go:18-20` dispatches to `sqlite.NewDB`, and `store/memo.go:113` calls `s.driver.CreateMemo()` which resolves to the SQLite implementation.

**h13**: Implementation — unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (wraps goldmark). Construction — `markdown.NewService()` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` in `NewAPIV1Service`. Holders — `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14**: Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`), and batch `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`). Extracted properties: `tags` (hashtags), `property.has_link`, `property.has_task_list`, `property.has_code`, `property.has_incomplete_tasks`, `property.title` (first H1 heading text).

**h15**:
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo gate) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query-level visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- `ListMemoComments` visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:156`
- `CreateMemoComment` parent-memo visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33`
- `ListMemoReactions` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82`
- `ListMemoAttachments` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- Attachment download `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422`
- RSS feed (public-only filter) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Sitemap (public-only filter) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- SSE event filtering `canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`

**r01**: False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is a purely in-memory implementation using Go's `sync.Map`, defined at `store/cache/cache.go`. Default TTL is 10 minutes (`DefaultConfig()` at line 57). No Redis dependency exists in `go.mod`.

**r02**: False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The only middleware registered (`server/server.go:52-53`) is `Recover` and a custom CORS handler. No rate limiting or throttling code exists in the codebase.

**r03**: False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler/` package is a generic cron library that is never wired into the server. The only background runner is the S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/`) that runs every 12 hours via a simple `time.Ticker`.

**r04**: False premise. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) with 4 goroutines consuming from it (lines 42-55). No external message broker dependencies exist in `go.mod`.

**r05**: False premise. There is no GraphQL API. The public API is defined using Protocol Buffers (protobuf) with gRPC and gRPC-Gateway for REST/HTTP transcoding. Proto service definitions are in `proto/api/v1/` (e.g. `memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`), with generated Go code in `proto/gen/api/v1/`.
